name: Easter Holiday 2026 to Cairo with Nile Cruise
description: A lifetime trip to Egypt during Easter holiday 2026, covering the major attractions of ancient Egyptians. Easter Nile Cruise vacation 2026 is the classical way to visit Egypt. Enjoy sailing the River Nile with sightseeing tours between Luxor & Aswan. Spend your Easter vacation in Egypt by the Pyramids & the Nile.

highlights: Easter Nile Cruise -Edfu And Kom Ombo Temples Tour
Easter Nile Cruise -Edfu- Luxor & Karnak Temples

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo, Egypt
itinerary.description: We provide meet & assist services at Cairo airport around the clock. Ibis Egypt Tours REP will be waiting for you at the arrival hall, holding a board reflecting your name. Our REP will help you in finishing the airport formalities, visa, customs, and luggage pick-up. then he will escort you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours REP will pick you up from your hotel after enjoying an international buffet breakfast. We start the tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Mykerinus at the famous Giza Plateau. Then we move to the Panorama area for a fabulous photo opportunity by the Pyramids. Continue the tour to the marvelous Sphinx and, the Valley Temple. Stop for a lunch meal at one of our recommended restaurants in Cairo. We conclude the Cairo tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, the oldest archaeological museum in the Middle East, and houses the largest collection of Pharaonic antiquities in the world. Return to your hotel in Cairo for an overnight stay. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo -Aswan -Easter Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: After breakfast, our REP will drop you off at Cairo Airport to fly south to Aswan. On arrival in Aswan, another REP will be waiting for you to escort you to the Nile Cruise boat for check-in. After lunch meal is served on board, our Egyptology guide will accompany you to visit the High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk, and Philae Temple at Isis Island. The Temple is dedicated to the two Goddesses Isis and Hathor. We drive back to the ship. The rest of the day is at leisure on your own in Aswan, as you may be interested in making some extra activities or tours, and have Dinner. Overnight onboard the ship in Aswan

itinerary.title: Easter Nile Cruise -Edfu And Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast on board the ship in Aswan. Start Sailing to Kom Ombo and a lunch meal will be served during sailing. Arrive at Kom Ombo before the sunset. Pay a visit to the Temple of Kom Ombo, shared by two Gods Sobek and Horus. Sail towards Edfu, and have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Easter Nile Cruise -Edfu- Luxor & Karnak Temples
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board the cruise in Edfu. A new adventure is waiting for you by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Temple of God Horus. Back to the ship to continue sailing to Luxor via Esna Lock., On arrival in Luxor, our Egyptology guide will give you an onsite lecture at the famous temple complex of Karnak & Luxor Temples, and have Dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Egypt Easter Vacation-West Bank tour - Cairo
itinerary.description: Disembark the Cruise after a tasty breakfast on board in Luxor. Our final tour in Luxor will be to the Valley of The Kings, Hatshepsut temple, and The two giant statues at the entrance of the west bank, the Colossi Of Memnon., Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Luxor airport, catch your flight back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic Airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final departure
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure. The pick-up time from the hotel depends on your flight departure time.
